styles.base: Korean traditional minhwa folk painting in ink-wash damchae style: confident black ink brush outlines, soft muted watercolor washes of indigo, ochre, persimmon red and pine green on aged hanji paper texture. Bright, clear, high contrast, faces large and readable. Joseon dynasty. No text, no letters anywhere.
styles.sil: Korean minhwa ink-wash painting on hanji paper mixed with bold acrylic painting in the style of a sunset landscape: sky of layered flat gray and silver clouds with ribbons of gold, orange and red glowing between them, figures and trees as solid black silhouettes, blue-violet shadows. Joseon dynasty. No text, no letters anywhere.
styles.web: Korean traditional minhwa folk painting in ink-wash damchae style, matching the style of the reference image: confident black ink brush outlines, soft muted watercolor washes of indigo, ochre, persimmon red and pine green on aged cream hanji paper. Bright and clear, faces large and readable. No text, no letters anywhere.

characters.GOKSAN: a broad plain faced woman in her thirties, pale cream jeogori with a dark red tie and a charcoal gray skirt, sturdy, sleeves rolled up, low bun
characters.MOTHERINLAW: an old woman in a gray jeogori and a dark blue skirt, sixties, thin and stern, white hair in a small bun
characters.YOUNGER: a grown adult woman in her twenties, never a child, as tall as the other women, light green jeogori and brown skirt, plain commoner cut, low bun
characters.HUSBAND: a man in his thirties with a topknot and a plain hemp jacket and gray trousers

scenes.S01: A winter village street of thatched houses under gray sky, thin villagers in worn hemp clothes standing in a long line with empty bowls in their hands, snow on the roofs, nobody smiling. Seen from a distance. Daylight. Every man has a topknot with a black headband or a black gat hat, and nobody wears a cap or any western brimmed hat.
scenes.S02: Exactly two people in a dim storeroom: MOTHERINLAW standing frozen with her mouth open, staring at rows of large brown earthen jars and stacked straw sacks, and GOKSAN beside her holding an open door. Daylight coming in from behind them.
scenes.S05: GOKSAN kneeling at a big black iron cauldron set in a clay stove in a Joseon kitchen, lifting its heavy black cast iron lid with both hands, the lid the same black iron as the cauldron and never wooden, white steam rising over her face. Firewood stacked beside. Nobody else, daylight.
scenes.S06: Exactly two people in a Joseon kitchen: MOTHERINLAW standing with her arms folded and a hard face, and GOKSAN kneeling at the cauldron with her back half turned, saying nothing. Steam between them. Daylight.
scenes.S07: GOKSAN crouching low among more than twenty large brown jars on a raised earthen terrace, spreading a white cloth over the open mouth of one jar with both hands at once, sleeves rolled up. Autumn daylight, a low tiled wall behind. Nobody else.
scenes.S08: MOTHERINLAW standing on an earthen terrace among many jars, one hand raised and pointing at them, her face angry, and GOKSAN standing a step back with her head lowered and her hands folded in front of her. Daylight.
scenes.S09: [SIL] Sunset over a thatched house, a woman carrying a wide flat basket on her head walking alone as a black silhouette, layered gray and silver clouds with ribbons of gold behind her.
scenes.S10: GOKSAN standing on a low ladder against a thatched roof, spreading sliced white radish on a straw mat laid on the roof, both arms reaching out. Autumn daylight, nobody else.
scenes.S11: Exactly two people in a room: HUSBAND sitting cross legged with a troubled face, one hand raised, and GOKSAN sitting on her heels across from him with her eyes down. A low table between them. Daylight.
scenes.S12: Exactly two people and nobody else: YOUNGER standing with her hands folded, MOTHERINLAW beside her looking pleased at her. A courtyard, daylight.
scenes.S13: MOTHERINLAW sits on a veranda smiling, holding the hand of kneeling YOUNGER. GOKSAN stands in the yard. Daylight.
scenes.S14: Exactly two people: MOTHERINLAW stands upright and holds out a big iron key, and YOUNGER bows her head and receives it with both hands held low. A storehouse door, daylight.
scenes.S16: GOKSAN alone at night carrying a large earthen jar in both arms toward a small wooden shed behind a house, a paper lantern hanging by the shed door. Night, nobody else.
scenes.S17: The inside of a dim storeroom seen from the doorway: rows of large brown jars along the walls, straw sacks stacked to the ceiling, bundles of dried vegetables hanging from the beams. Nobody in the picture.
scenes.S18: A wide dry rice paddy cracked into plates of hard earth filling the whole frame, withered brown shoots, faded hills far behind under a white empty sky. Absolutely no people and no animals. Harsh daylight.
scenes.S19: Several villagers in worn hemp clothes standing at the edge of a cracked paddy, all looking up at the empty white sky, one old man with his hat in his hand. Seen from a distance, harsh daylight. Every man has a topknot with a black headband or a black gat hat, and nobody wears a cap or any western brimmed hat.
scenes.S20: An empty autumn field with nothing standing in it, only stubble and dust, a lone crow on a bare branch, gray hills behind. No people. Late autumn daylight.
scenes.S21: A market street with almost empty stalls, only a few grain sacks left, a crowd of people pressing around one stall with their hands out, the merchant holding up both palms. Daylight, tense faces. Every man has a topknot with a black headband or a black gat hat, and nobody wears a cap or any western brimmed hat.
scenes.S23: A storehouse interior filling the frame: bare floor boards, two small empty straw sacks in the corner, YOUNGER standing in the middle looking down at them with a pale face, her jeogori short and ending above the waist, never a long robe. Plain plank walls, no writing anywhere.
scenes.S24: Close view of two very thin children in worn patched hemp clothes sitting on a snowy doorstep, hollow cheeks and dull eyes, an empty wooden bowl on the ground between them, snow all around. Nothing floating in the air. No writing anywhere. Winter daylight.
scenes.S25: MOTHERINLAW sitting alone on the edge of a cold wooden veranda, her hands gripping her knees, staring at nothing, her face gray. Winter daylight, snow in the yard. Nobody else.
scenes.S26: GOKSAN standing in front of a small wooden shed in the back yard, pulling open its two doors with both hands, snow on the ground around her. Winter daylight, nobody else.
scenes.S27: Exactly two people at a shed door: MOTHERINLAW with both hands over her mouth staring inside, and GOKSAN standing quietly beside the open door. Inside, rows of large jars and stacked straw sacks. Winter daylight.
scenes.S28: A close view filling the frame: MOTHERINLAW's face, her eyes wide and wet, her mouth half open, deep wrinkles, a gray winter light on her. Nobody else in the picture.
scenes.S30: GOKSAN standing at a house gate speaking to several villagers who have come with empty bowls, gesturing them in with one hand, her face steady. Winter daylight, snow on the wall. Every man has a topknot with a black headband or a black gat hat, and nobody wears a cap or any western brimmed hat.
scenes.S31: A steaming iron cauldron in a courtyard. GOKSAN, a woman, stands over it ladling porridge, and MOTHERINLAW stands beside her. Both are women. A line of thin villagers waits with bowls, every man with a topknot and no cap. Winter daylight.
scenes.S32: Two thin children in patched undyed hemp clothes sitting on a straw mat, each holding a plain white porcelain bowl with both hands and drinking, a thin woman in a worn hemp jeogori crouching beside them watching. The bowls are plain white or brass with no painted flowers, never Chinese style. Winter daylight, steam rising.
scenes.S33: Two people on a wooden floor: MOTHERINLAW bows her head low toward GOKSAN, who sits upright startled, one hand raised palm out and the other on her knee. Each hand has exactly five fingers. Daylight indoors.
scenes.S34: GOKSAN sitting indoors with her hands in her lap, her eyes down, speaking quietly, and MOTHERINLAW listening with her head bowed. A paper window behind them. Daylight, exactly two people.
scenes.S35: MOTHERINLAW holding out a large iron key with both hands toward GOKSAN, who gently pushes it back with one palm, shaking her head slightly. Exactly two people indoors, daylight.
scenes.S36: Exactly five villagers at a house gate holding sacks of grain and bowing toward GOKSAN, who raises one hand palm out to refuse them, her other hand down at her side. Each hand has exactly five fingers. Every face clearly drawn. Spring daylight, green hills. Every man wears a bare topknot or a black gat hat, no cap.
scenes.S37: [SIL] Sunset over a village, several people bent over burying large jars in the earth beside their houses as black silhouettes, layered silver clouds and a band of gold light behind them.
